checks.model: Synthetic localhost SSE, dummy credentials only

features: Explain and Explain with full paper are available directly in the native PDF selection popup and generated-text selection menu
Full-paper entry starts one combined explanation request without a preliminary local-context request, using the existing Zotero PDFWorker extraction path
Both selection entries share the native highlight and saved conversation; Explain reopens existing answers without a new model call
Original and generated selections share a 20,000-character cap and accept complete paragraphs, preserving equations and trailing text without silent truncation
Long passages use short navigation labels and a Selected passage heading while preserving their complete source and model payload
Paragraph instructions explain the entire selected argument instead of picking one term
Switching a loading local request to full-paper context cancels the old stream and uses job identity and transaction guards to prevent stale writes
New entry labels, titles and privacy hints are translated in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and English
Retain circular blue Send/Stop, Enter and IME behavior, auto-sizing input, full-paper answer replacement, TeX rendering, newline recovery and highlight-linked deletion

boundaries.nativeSelectionTest: Invoke actual renderTextSelectionPopup handlers and click generated DOM buttons; native generated-paragraph range selection uses Gecko
boundaries.pdfGesture: Mouse drag across actual PDF canvas text was not separately automated; existing annotation geometry is passed through Zotero APIs
boundaries.nativeClickTest: Actual annotation sidebar card; PDF canvas coordinate clicks not separately simulated
boundaries.pdfExtraction: All extractable text from the bound PDF; scanned PDFs require OCR and missing formula symbols cannot be reliably reconstructed
boundaries.fullPaperContext: Full paper text is not truncated; provider context limits can reject long papers and prior answers are retained
boundaries.fullPaperStorage: Full text is sent only after choosing full-paper explanation or regeneration; it is not written into the knowledge-tree archive
boundaries.realProvider: Requests use local synthetic SSE; real API availability and answer quality are not verified
boundaries.historicalTextOnlySessions: No automatic highlight creation without PDF selection geometry
boundaries.generatedSelection: Only generated answer content within one session and one reply; drafts, user messages and cross-reply ranges are excluded
boundaries.normalizationScope: Conservative newline recovery applies to model output; user input and PDF selections are preserved
